Update Content:
Android Version
1. Upgraded from Android 15 to Android 16 for enhanced security, more features, and a better user experience.

OS Version
1. Upgraded from XOS 15.1.2 to XOS 16.2.0 for a smarter user interface and a refreshed look for your device.

Wallpapers
1. Added the Depth-Effect Homescreen feature that lets you enable a depth effect with uploaded portrait wallpapers or built-in wallpapers, giving the home screen a more layered look.
2. Supported setting live photos as live wallpapers to bring vivid moments back to life.
3. Supported generating a theme that matches the style or colors of an uploaded static wallpaper.

Home Screen
1. Supported displaying app download and update status on icons.
2. Supported automatic name suggestions when grouping apps into folders.
3. Added the Featured channel to the widget center.
4. Added the 1×1 One-Tap Lock Screen widget.

Notification Center and Control Center
1. Optimized the layout and visual presentation of Notification Center and Control Center with an all-new superfluid design and smoother animations for a more refined look.
2. Added seamless status bar transition animations when bringing up Notification Center or Control Center for smoother visuals.
3. Optimized notification grouping. Grouped notifications are now stacked and can be expanded with a tap for a smoother and more polished experience.
4. Optimized notification management. You can now go to Settings > Notifications & Status Bar, tap an app, then select By App under Notification Group.
5. Added seamless transition animations when expanding the Wi-Fi or Mobile Data card from Control Center for a more polished visual experience.

Lock Screen
1. Large lock screen clock: Features an all-new layout and a new glass-inspired large clock design, with more font and color options.
2. Depth effect: Automatically identifies the subject in the wallpaper to create a depth effect on the lock screen, making it feel more immersive and layered.
3. Personalized editing: Goes beyond simply changing wallpapers with a complete customization framework, supporting custom clocks, depth effects, wallpaper extension, and more on the lock screen—making every lock screen combination unique.
4. AOD continuity: Supports custom AOD system styles or seamless continuation from the lock screen, for a smooth transition between AOD and the lock screen.

Joy Connect
1. A newly upgraded device management hub that lets services flow freely across multiple devices, enabling smart living in all scenarios.

Security & Privacy
1. Dual System: Optimized the experience and added support for app transfer between the two systems.

Communication
1. Intelligently identifies data traffic and recognizes app scenarios such as video and voice calls, e-commerce, ride-hailing, and order-taking, delivering network acceleration benefits under weak-signal conditions.
2. Boosts power under weak network conditions, improving data smoothness and call stability in weak-signal scenarios.
3. Faster network recovery in elevator scenarios, allowing the cellular network to quickly switch from 2G/3G back to 4G when the elevator stops or when you exit the elevator.
4. Optimized power consumption when Hotspot is on while the phone is in your pocket, reducing device heating.

Games
1. Added Esports Mode for greater spatial immersion in games.
2. Added AI voice prompts and intelligent triggers, supporting AI voice announcements for game assistance and support, as well as customized image recognition to trigger automated actions.
